column1: # IA Engineering - inline suppression patterns (Standards/CODE_QUALITY_STANDARD.md, No Inline Suppression)
# ONE LIST, TWO READERS. The Claude Code hook (hooks/block-inline-suppression.sh,
# Edit/Write/MultiEdit) and the Pull Request check (check-inline-suppression.sh,
# the added lines of a diff) both read this file, so a directive the hook learns
# to refuse is reported by the check on the same commit. Two copies drift; the
# hook would then pass what CI reports, or the reverse.
# Format: label<TAB>extended regular expression, one per line. Blank lines and
# lines beginning with # are ignored. Matched case-insensitively, per line, with
# grep -iE. The label is what a finding prints.
# This file quotes every directive in order to forbid it, so both readers exempt
# it by path (Adapters/scripts/suppression-patterns.tsv), as they exempt the
# documentation that quotes them. Both FAIL CLOSED when it is missing: a missing
# pattern list is not an empty one.
